metadata.title: BIS International Banking Statistics - Global Capital Flow Atlas
metadata.source: Bank for International Settlements (BIS) Locational & Consolidated Banking Statistics
metadata.methodology_status: Hybrid Calibration Framework: Global Aggregates Ingested via BIS SDMX 2.1 REST API (2018Q1-2026Q1 verified); 2026Q2 is a Cached Estimate pending official BIS Oct 30 release; 2026Q3-Q4 are Scenario Projections; Country and Bilateral Corridors Model-Allocated via Iterative Proportional Fitting RAS Balancing.
metadata.data_allocation_policy: 全球总量锚定 BIS 官方公布值 (2026Q1 及之前) / 待发布估算 (2026Q2)，国别总额与双边走廊基于 RAS 最大熵算法求解

sdmx_ingestion_api.series_description: Cross-border bank claims on all sectors in all currencies (amounts outstanding)

scenario_projection_model.specification: Heuristic Trend Scenario Range (Not formal ARX econometrics)

ras_matrix_balancing.row_marginal_constraint: Reporting Country Total Claims (LBS Table A6.2)

country_lbs_claims_and_liabilities.source: Model-allocated from global macro anchor using BIS reporting participation shares
country_lbs_claims_and_liabilities.accounting_identity: Strict sum equality: sum(claims) == sum(liabilities) == total_claims

bilateral_corridors.source: Biproportional Iterative Proportional Fitting (RAS / Maximum Entropy)
bilateral_corridors.marginal_constraints: Row totals match country claims; Column totals match country liabilities
bilateral_corridors.post_export_discretization: 0.1 Bn exact integer apportionment with row-neutral column shift

cbs_early_warning_and_capital.source: Stylized indicators calibrated to Basel III regulatory guidelines

academic_citations: BIS Locational Banking Statistics (Table A6.2) & Consolidated Banking Statistics (Table B4)
Eisenberg, L., & Noe, T. H. (2001). Systemic risk in financial systems. Management Science, 47(2), 236-249.
Borio, C., McCauley, R., & McGuire, P. (2017/2022). FX swaps and forwards: missing global debt. BIS Quarterly Review.
Cerutti, E., Claessens, S., & Puy, D. (2019). Push versus pull factors in international bank lending. Journal of International Economics.

countries.name: United States
countries.desc: 全球核心储备货币发行国，跨国美元信贷流动与回流源头

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.desc: 欧洲美元 (Eurodollar) 与全球银行间同业清算与跨境融资超级枢纽

countries.name: Japan
countries.desc: 全球最大对外净债权国之一，日元套息交易与对外长期资产输出国

countries.name: Germany
countries.desc: 欧元区核心主权信用锚，跨境银行稳健资产与 TARGET2 净债权方

countries.name: France
countries.desc: 欧洲大型跨国商业银行总部所在地，高额跨境双向综合敞口

countries.name: Switzerland
countries.desc: 传统离岸财富与避险中心，高度国际化银行体系与汇率避险纽带

countries.name: Cayman Islands
countries.desc: 关键离岸对冲基金与表外特殊目的载体 (SPV) 登记中心，美元转口枢纽

countries.name: Singapore
countries.desc: 东南亚跨国资金池调拨中心与亚洲美元市场 (ADM) 核心清算节点

countries.name: Hong Kong SAR
countries.desc: 全球最大离岸人民币中心，内地企业跨境美元与离岸银团投融资门户

countries.name: Luxembourg
countries.desc: 泛欧投资基金与跨境资产托管大本营，资金再循环转口通道

countries.name: Netherlands
countries.desc: 欧洲跨国企业财资中心集中地，庞大的外商直接投资与关联信贷中转

countries.name: China
countries.desc: 全球第二大经济体，本币双边互换网络主导者，跨境投融资与共建一带一路资金源

countries.name: South Korea
countries.desc: 全球半导体及高科技贸易链节点，商业银行对美元离岸短期流动性高敏感度

countries.name: India
countries.desc: 快速成长的南亚核心，企业外币商业借款 (ECB) 持续上升

countries.name: Brazil
countries.desc: 拉美最大经济体，大宗商品出口信贷依赖美元，外资银行本地分支规模庞大

countries.name: Mexico
countries.desc: 北美供应链重构直接受益方，外资银行本地实体分支体系完备

countries.name: Türkiye
countries.desc: 短期外债展期压力大，外汇储备充足率偏低，跨国银行信贷紧缩风向标

countries.name: Australia
countries.desc: 大宗商品金融，四大主要商业银行积极参与离岸美元与离岸澳元负债融通

countries.name: Canada
countries.desc: 高度融入北美美元生态，六大商业银行跨境债权规模巨大且风险评级极佳

countries.name: Italy
countries.desc: 欧洲主权债务与银行利差对照样本，法德银行对意风险敞口敏感

countries.name: Spain
countries.desc: 西班牙银行巨头 (Santander, BBVA) 在拉美市场占据核心系统性信贷敞口

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.desc: 石油美元盈余输出国，主权财富基金与跨国银行存款净盈余配置方

countries.name: South Africa
countries.desc: 非洲金融市场流动性门户，深度外资参与与经常账户赤字压力
